name: qship
description: Open-source mirror of the qship pipeline — Jira ticket to production PR in one slash command. Hook-enforced, resumable, parallel/epic-mode capable, with optional Codex CLI integration for diversified model review.

plugins.name: qship
plugins.description: Bootstrapper for the qship pipeline. Installs a single configurator skill (/qship:configure) that walks you through ~25 questions about your codebase, then renders the 21-skill pipeline (plan / implement / TDD / review / E2E / PR) into your ~/.claude/skills/ tree. Hook-enforced, resumable, parallel/epic-mode capable. Works with both Claude Code and Codex CLI. Recommended companion plugins from anthropics/claude-plugins-official: superpowers, feature-dev, code-review, code-simplifier, pr-review-toolkit.
